Mayawati Demands Regularisation of Contract Workers in UP

Bahujan Samaj Party (BSP) chief Mayawati has demanded the regularisation of contract workers employed under the National Health Mission (NHM) in Uttar Pradesh. She stated that outsourcing is an exploitative arrangement and called for the contract staff to be regularised. The demand was raised by Mayawati, who also serves as a former Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh.
